details: Package @wrenfield/viem published under an individual scope shares its name with the widely-used viem Ethereum library. No malicious behavior was identified in the scanned contents — no install-time fetch-and-execute, no credential access, no exfiltration, no silent-relay, and no install-time destruction. The concern is purely name-similarity: an installer typing the scope incorrectly or following an incorrect tutorial could pull this scoped package instead of the upstream viem. Routing to human review so a maintainer reputation / intent assessment can be made before any public advisory.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
